page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.t6-c1m4.2xlarge is a burstable, general-purpose virtual machine instance running on the KVM hypervisor. It features an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor with an x86_64 architecture, providing 8 virtual CPUs mapped to 4 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled. The CPU operates at a base speed of 2.5 GHz and includes a 35 MB L3 cache. The instance is equipped with 32.0 GB of system memory, yielding 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. It does not include dedicated local storage or GPU hardware, and the baseline network bandwidth is rated at 0 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks reflect the burstable nature of the CPU allocation. Single-core performance is relatively weak, as shown by a Geekbench single-core score of 1039.0 and a stress-ng single-core CPU score of 1303.28. However, multi-core performance scales to average levels, with a Geekbench multi-core score of 4827.0 and a Passmark CPU score of 10087.86. Memory performance is stable, with read-only large block bandwidth reaching 61.66 GB/sec and write large block bandwidth at 33.94 GB/sec. The instance handles database operations and web serving adequately, achieving 9.62 million operations per second in Redis SET tests and 8.26 GB/sec in static web serving throughput.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the burstable CPU model allows for a lower entry cost compared to dedicated-core instances, making it suitable for workloads with variable CPU utilization. However, sustained high-compute tasks will deplete CPU credits, leading to throttled performance. This instance is best suited for general-purpose workloads with intermittent resource demands, such as development environments, low-traffic web servers, code compilation, and lightweight database operations.
